CONNECT.title: Connecting to the TIA Portal
CONNECT.finding: Existing-process attachment is documented; runtime options/HSP must be installed. Resolver registration must precede JIT compilation of Siemens-dependent code.

FIREWALL.title: TIA Portal Openness firewall
FIREWALL.finding: Attachment can prompt for authorization. No registry whitelist edits or prompt auto-acceptance are implemented.

OPEN.title: Opening a project
OPEN.finding: Project must not be open in another Portal instance; ordinary Open does not upgrade. Protected-project authentication requires an explicit supported mechanism.

CREATE.title: Creating a project
CREATE.finding: Create receives parent DirectoryInfo and project name, creating a named subdirectory and project file.

SAVE.title: Saving a project
SAVE.finding: Requires attachment and an open project; Save and SaveAs have distinct effects.

CLOSE.title: Closing a project
CLOSE.finding: Requires attachment and a project opened by the application. Close is an explicit action.

ATTR.title: Read operations for attributes
ATTR.finding: Read via IEngineeringObject metadata and GetAttribute; dynamic attributes depend on the current object state.

TREE.title: Determining the object structure and attributes
TREE.finding: Requires attachment and an open project; compositions and attributes expose the object hierarchy.

PLC.title: Querying PLC and HMI targets
PLC.finding: SoftwareContainer is a device-item service; check its software target type before treating it as PLC software.

GROUPS.title: Enumerating user-defined block groups
GROUPS.finding: Requires a selected PLC in an open project; group traversal is recursive and Find is composition-local.

BLOCKS.title: Enumerating all blocks
BLOCKS.finding: Block collection enumeration and local named lookup are documented; wrapper recursion is explicit.

INFO.title: Querying information of a block/user data type
INFO.finding: Modified and compile timestamps are UTC. Consistency is native state, not inferred from successful attribute reads.

TAGS.title: Enumerating PLC tag tables in a folder
TAGS.finding: Enumerate the selected system or user-group composition; root enumeration does not imply recursive coverage.

EXPORT_BLOCK.title: Exporting blocks
EXPORT_BLOCK.finding: Requires attachment, open project and offline PLC; documented XML export covers consistent supported blocks/types. Protected and special block rules need separate review.

IMPORT_BLOCK.title: Importing block
IMPORT_BLOCK.finding: Requires offline PLC. Imported XML can remain inconsistent; missing instance DBs are not automatically created. Redundant data conflicts can fail import.

EXPORT_TYPE.title: Exporting user data type
EXPORT_TYPE.finding: Requires offline PLC; uses a selected PlcType and FileInfo destination.

IMPORT_TYPE.title: Importing user data type
IMPORT_TYPE.finding: Requires offline PLC; malformed referenced-type syntax causes an exception.

EXPORT_TAG.title: Exporting PLC tag tables
EXPORT_TAG.finding: One XML file per table; recursive folder traversal is available. This wrapper deliberately exports a selected root table only.

IMPORT_TAG.title: Importing PLC tag table
IMPORT_TAG.finding: Import targets system-group or user-group TagTables. Manual example permits Override; adapter keeps it opt-in.

COMPILE.title: Compiling a project
COMPILE.finding: All devices must be offline. ICompilable returns aggregate counts and nested messages. Password-protected safety compilation requires login; failure may throw. Timestamps are UTC.

LOGIN.title: LoginToSafetyOfflineProgram
LOGIN.finding: Wrong/unset password, non-offline state, missing Safety license or disallowed safety changes can cause exceptions; UMAC restrictions apply.

LOGOFF.title: LogoffFromSafetyOfflineProgram
LOGOFF.finding: Logoff can fail when password, modification permission, offline state or Safety license requirements are unmet; cleanup must not conceal failure.

SESSION_OPEN.title: Opening local/exclusive session
SESSION_OPEN.finding: Opening an exclusive session automatically locks the server project; authentication events are required for protected server projects.

SESSION_SAVE.title: Saving a local session
SESSION_SAVE.finding: Save applies to engineering/exclusive sessions; a server-project session causes MultiuserException. This is not server commit.

SESSION_CLOSE.title: Closing local session
SESSION_CLOSE.finding: Close applies to server, multiuser and exclusive sessions and discards pending changes.

M151.title: M151
M151.finding: Read pp97,116,119-121: cross-instance open exclusion, all-device offline compile prerequisite, explicit Save/Close. Other chapters remain unreviewed in this pass.

M16.title: M16
M16.finding: Read pp129,870-872,912-913: all-device offline compilation and offline PLC block/type import/export requirements.

M17.title: M17
M17.finding: Read pp137,703,996: all-device offline compilation, discard-on-close local sessions and offline block import. Remaining chapters require review.

COMPILE21.title: COMPILE21
COMPILE21.finding: Read: all-device offline prerequisite and safety login requirement; no cross-version inference.
